flow: Build the ICP from the problem and outcome rather than product or title, and run the Five Whys until you reach the emotional reason the buyer will act.
Score accounts on 5 to 7 criteria and disqualify 20 to 30% of open deals. A strong ICP shows roughly a 3x win-rate gap between high and low scores.
Keep lists at 100 leads or fewer, split a 10,000-lead list into 10 x 1,000 segments, cap each sending box at 50 or fewer per day, and email more than one person per company.
Gate ABM entry at about $20,000 ACV or CFO sign-off. Work a short, tiered account list rather than 1,000 accounts, and run sales and marketing as one operating system.
Fire pre-SDR ad campaigns 2 days to 2 weeks before outreach, target open opportunities with ads that answer the top 10 objections, and mine champion job changes.

Time-box any POV or pilot at 2 or 4 weeks with agreed KPIs. Track accounts in weekly meetings, read no impressions as a distribution problem and no engagement as a content problem, and never ask for more budget to rescue a weak pilot.
